evidence.source: owner-supplied iPhone screenshot in the current task
evidence.observation: In dark theme, logo-full ended with a Brand Beige pin and pale inner-band composites instead of the Brand Blue pin and official-mark-aligned inner colours.
evidence.cause: The exact v2 runtime intentionally maps unqualified full motifs to Brand Beige under data-theme=dark. The logo preview host did not override that general decorative-motif rule.
evidence.boundary: The screenshot is evidence of a theme-cascade defect in this library preview. It does not authorize editing the exact owner-supplied runtime bytes or changing other motif kinds.

selectedFix.reason: The runtime already exposes its governed blue-ink route. Selecting it on logo-full prevents the dark-theme decorative override while preserving the supplied component and animation geometry byte-for-byte. The library host and regenerated portable logo-full SVG also lock the official #0195CB wedge instead of the runtime's generic token-derived wedge.

requiredInvariants: logo-full currentColor resolves to rgb(29, 68, 151) in light and dark themes
logo-full pin fill resolves to rgb(29, 68, 151) in light and dark themes
logo-full inner colour composites remain based on Brand Blue in light and dark themes
logo-full priority wedge resolves to rgb(1, 149, 203) in light and dark themes
logo-full and logo-quiet still start together, settle at 2050 ms, hold, and replay together at 5000 ms
reduced motion shows the same complete final states without replay
the copied logo component snippet includes ink=blue and --lm-wedge=#0195CB
non-logo motif theme behavior remains unchanged

productionBoundary.identityBoundary: The assembled mark remains a motif and does not replace the official logo asset.
productionBoundary.optionalRuntimeApiBoundary: Optional replay and loop capabilities remain unapproved for downstream use without a separate job-specific owner decision.
